case: licence register against the actual files and versions
targets: lib/license-register.mjs loadRegister / inventory / unresolved / distributionGate / exportNotices

checks.name: register loads
checks.expect: ok with one record for each of the 8 kinds

checks.name: GSAP
checks.expect: gsap-core and gsap-plugins are unresolved; distribution_blockers contains gsap-standard-license-no-code-visual-animation-builder (open); distributionGate.ok is false

checks.name: flag cannot clear it
steps: set any environment variable or adapter flag
checks.expect: distributionGate unchanged: only a dated register edit with recorded advice or permission clears it; the runtime is NOT removed

checks.name: version drift
checks.setup: in a COPY of the skill folder change the header of vendor/gsap.min.js to 3.15.0
checks.expect: inventory reports 'says version 3.15.0, the register records 3.14.2: recheck'

checks.name: unrecorded vendored file
checks.expect: inventory lists it as uncovered (unresolved), not permitted

checks.name: export package
checks.expect: notices for three-js and sfx-library only; the others listed as external requirements, not embedded

checks.name: ideas-only
checks.expect: reference-material is ideas_only; no copied code or text is attributed to it

checks.name: no purchase
checks.expect: no code path buys or activates a licence or paid access
